name: rosetta-unprimeable-numbers
code:
use default

let limit = 10_000_000
let composite = LIST()

for _ in 0::limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

let factor mut = 2

while factor * factor <= limit do
    if !composite[factor] then
        let multiple mut = factor * factor

        while multiple <= limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + factor
        od
    fi

    factor = factor + 1
od

is_prime(value: int) -> bool => value > 1 /\ !composite[value]

is_unprimeable(value: int) -> bool is
    if is_prime(value) then return false fi

    let place mut = 1

    while place <= value do
        let kept = value - value / place % 10 * place

        for digit in 0::9 do
            if is_prime(kept + digit * place) then return false fi
        od

        place = place * 10
    od

    true
si

unprimeables() -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 99

    do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        if is_unprimeable(candidate) then
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

let terms = unprimeables() |> take(600) |> collect_list()

write_line("the first 35 unprimeable numbers:")
write_line("  {terms[0..35] |> map(t => "{t}") |> join(" ")}")

write_line("")
write_line("the 600th unprimeable number is {terms[599]:N0}")

write_line("")
write_line("the lowest unprimeable number ending in each digit:")

for last in 0::9 do
    let found =
        for candidate in unprimeables() do
            if candidate % 10 == last then break candidate fi
        od

    let lowest = found!

    write_line("  {last}: {lowest:N0}")
od
